name: elenchus
description: Own your work while using AI: Socratic learning gates and an owner's paper per project.

plugins.name: elenchus
plugins.description: Socratic learning gates: explain, predict or propose first; work opens only after assessed understanding. Runs in Claude Code and Cowork.

plugins.name: elenchus-ui
plugins.description: Optional, Claude Code CLI only: focus card beside the input, compact Elenchus tool rendering, two themes. Needs elenchus.

plugins.name: ownership
plugins.description: Stay the owner of AI-assisted work: one owner's paper per project in Typst. Every decision is inherited, yours, or owned, and only a passed Elenchus gate makes it owned. Same flow for new and existing projects.
